title: 构筑华夏 · 中国传统建筑与结构术语表
titleEn: Built in China — Glossary of Chinese Traditional Architecture and Structure
scope: 首批 74 条术语，覆盖构件、连接、屋面、结构体系、形制与礼制、材料与做法、桥与基础、民族与地方类型八类。
scopeEn: 74 entries in the first release, across eight categories: components, joints, roof forms, structural systems, form and rank, materials and techniques, bridges and foundations, and regional and ethnic types.

fieldNotes.pinyin: 带声调符号；连写不加空格，仅专名之间以空格分隔。
fieldNotes.relatedCases: 引用 catalog.json 中的案例 id，已在构建时校验存在性。
fieldNotes.relatedStructures: 引用构造类别 id（catalog.meta.json 的 vocabularies.structureTypes），已校验。
fieldNotes.note: 使用提示：常见误用、时代限定或教学表达边界。

disclaimer: 所有受力、构造与形制说明均为教学示意，非施工工序、非工程计算。

teachingNotice.labelZh: 教学示意，非施工/工程模型
teachingNotice.labelEn: Teaching illustration — not a construction or engineering model.
teachingNotice.forceNoteZh: 受力箭头为定性说明，非工程计算；箭头仅表示传力方向，不表示大小。
teachingNotice.forceNoteEn: Force arrows are qualitative, not an engineering calculation; they indicate the direction of load transfer, not its magnitude.
appliesTo: 受力箭头、推力线与传力路径
mustNotClaim: 不得声称是测绘成果或复原依据
不得给出荷载、应力、允许跨度等工程数值

terms.definitionZh: 柱头与额枋上由斗、栱、昂、升层层叠置的组合构件，是中国木构把屋檐出挑重量传回柱心的关键装置。
terms.definitionEn: A layered cluster of blocks, arms and cantilevering elements set on the column head and tie beam; it is the mechanism by which a Chinese timber frame carries the weight of the projecting eaves back to the columns.
terms.note: 受力箭头只表示传力方向，不表示大小；具体做法随时代与地域差别很大。

terms.definitionZh: 计量斗栱的「层」的单位，一铺作指一组完整的出跳关系。宋《营造法式》以铺作为模数组织大木作。
terms.definitionEn: The unit that counts tiers of a bracket set: one puzuo is one complete set of projections. In the Song Yingzao Fashi the puzuo is the modular unit that organises the whole timber frame.
terms.note: 「七铺作双抄双下昂」是描述斗栱层数与出跳方向的术语，不等于构件数量。

terms.definitionZh: 安在柱头最下的大斗，承托整组斗栱，是柱与栱之间的过渡块。
terms.definitionEn: The largest block seated directly on the column head; it receives the whole bracket assembly and acts as the transition between column and arms.

terms.definitionZh: 向屋外挑出的栱，出跳时把屋檐重量向外传递并引回柱心。
terms.definitionEn: The arm that projects outward beyond the column line, carrying the eave weight outward and back toward the column axis.

terms.definitionZh: 架在阑额之上、不向外挑出的栱，联系相邻两柱并承托其上构件。
terms.definitionEn: The arm that sits on the tie beam without projecting outward; it links two neighbouring columns and carries what is placed above it.

terms.definitionZh: 由斗栱层伸出、向外下方倾斜的斜置构件，把屋檐的重量引向柱心，是出挑最远的一根杆件。
terms.definitionEn: A sloping member cantilevered out of the bracket cluster; it reaches the furthest outward and directs the eave load back toward the column axis.

terms.definitionZh: 斗栱之上与昂、耍头相交的前伸构件，像一条伸出的短梁，端部承檐椽。
terms.definitionEn: The forward-projecting member that crosses the ang above the bracket cluster; it reads as a short beam and carries the eave rafters at its tip.

terms.definitionZh: 一组斗栱中最外一跳的栱，其上安三才升承托外檐。
terms.definitionEn: The outermost arm in a bracket set; the small blocks on top of it receive the eave purlin.

terms.definitionZh: 十字形置于华栱与泥道栱交叉处的小斗，把两个方向的栱锁在一起。
terms.definitionEn: A small cruciform block set where the outward and inward arms cross, locking the two directions together.

terms.definitionZh: 斗栱最上层顺次叠置的三块小斗，承托檩或椽。
terms.definitionEn: Three small blocks stacked in sequence at the top of a bracket set, carrying the purlin or rafters.

terms.definitionZh: 插在柱与额枋之间的小三角撑，缩短柱枋接触处的有效长度，是明清木构常见的加固件。
terms.definitionEn: A small triangular brace fitted between column and tie beam; it shortens the effective span at the joint and is a common reinforcement in Ming and Qing frames.

terms.definitionZh: 上端不落地、悬在梁枋之下的短柱，多见于楼阁与外廊，以增加出挑层次。
terms.definitionEn: A short column that hangs from the beams above instead of reaching the ground, used in towers and galleries to add another tier of projection.

terms.definitionZh: 由数根圆木拼合并在表面做出瓜棱凹槽而成的柱子，是宋代木构的标志做法。
terms.definitionEn: A column made by laminating several round timbers and carving melon-like flutes into the surface — a signature of Song timberwork.
terms.note: 保国寺大殿被公认为唯一能印证《营造法式》相关做法的宋代实物。

terms.definitionZh: 横贯两柱之间、联系柱列的横木，柱间传递水平力的主要杆件之一。
terms.definitionEn: A horizontal beam spanning between two columns; together with the columns it forms the tie that resists horizontal movement in the frame.

terms.definitionZh: 铺在阑额之上、贯穿柱列的通长扁木，逐层叠置后形成平直的承檩面，是宋代的重要构件。
terms.definitionEn: A continuous flat timber laid on top of the tie beam and run along the whole column line; stacked in layers it forms a level purlin-bearing surface.

terms.definitionZh: 置于梁与蜀柱之间、呈驼峰状的小木垫块，用来缩短梁的支承长度。
terms.definitionEn: A small saddle-shaped block placed between a beam and the short strut above it, reducing the beam's effective span.

terms.definitionZh: 梁上立起、承托上一层梁或檩的短柱。
terms.definitionEn: A short post standing on a beam to carry the beam or purlin above it.

terms.definitionZh: 跨于梁背之上、左右对称斜置以互相抵撑的构件，是早期构架抵抗侧向变形的重要手段。
terms.definitionEn: A pair of symmetrically leaning members crossing above a beam and bracing against each other; an early means of resisting lateral deformation.

terms.definitionZh: 自柱或梁斜向上托住檩的斜撑，与叉手共同构成早期梁架的稳定体系。
terms.definitionEn: A sloping prop leaning from the column or beam up to the purlin; together with the crossed braces it forms the early stabilising system of a frame.

terms.definitionZh: 横向架在梁架之上、承托椽的纵向长杆，是屋面荷载汇集的第一层。
terms.definitionEn: A longitudinal member laid across the frames to carry the rafters; it is the first level at which roof loads are collected.

terms.definitionZh: 铺在檩上、承托望板与屋面的小径杆，密排程度直接决定屋面质感。
terms.definitionEn: A small member laid closely on the purlins to carry the roof boards and covering; its spacing is a major part of how a roof reads.

terms.definitionZh: 钉在椽上的连续木板，承接瓦件或苫背，隔离室内外。
terms.definitionEn: Continuous boarding nailed over the rafters; it carries the tile or thatch and separates the interior from the weather.

terms.definitionZh: 柱脚下的石质承台，把木柱的集中荷载扩散到地基，并隔绝地面潮气。
terms.definitionEn: The stone plinth under a column; it spreads the concentrated load into the ground and keeps the timber foot clear of damp.

terms.definitionZh: 柱础做成上凹如覆盆的样式，柱脚安入凹槽，是唐宋木构常见做法。
terms.definitionEn: A column base with a dished, basin-like top into which the timber foot is seated; a common Tang and Song detail.

terms.definitionZh: 一端做凸榫、另一端凿对应卯眼，靠几何咬合与摩擦把两根木料锁定，不用钉铆的连接方式。
terms.definitionEn: A joint in which a projecting tenon fits a matching cut socket, locking two timbers by geometry and friction rather than by nails or bolts.
terms.note: 河姆渡出土的多榫多孔构件被视作中国已知最早的榫卯实例之一。

terms.definitionZh: 凸出的一端，插入对方构件的卯眼中。
terms.definitionEn: The projecting end of a timber that fits into a matching socket.

terms.definitionZh: 凿出的凹槽，承接榫头。
terms.definitionEn: The cut socket that receives the tenon.

terms.definitionZh: 榫头做成外宽内窄的梯形，方向上无法拔出，靠形状而非摩擦锁定。
terms.definitionEn: A tenon cut in a trapezoid that widens outward; it cannot be withdrawn in that direction and is locked by shape rather than by friction.

terms.definitionZh: 贯穿两块构件的通长木条或铁件，把两片构件夹持成整体，是大木作常用的水平联系手段。
terms.definitionEn: A continuous bar or iron strap passing through two members to clamp them into one; a common means of tying large timber members horizontally.

terms.definitionZh: 梁头做成带有凹曲肩部的榫，插入柱头或瓜棱柱的卯口，限制梁的转动与滑移。
terms.definitionEn: A beam head cut with a concave shoulder so it seats into the mortise of a column head, limiting rotation and sliding.

terms.definitionZh: 用折线控制屋面坡度的方法：脊部陡、檐部缓，使屋面形成反宇曲线的弧度。
terms.definitionEn: The method of setting the roof profile as a broken line — steep at the ridge, flattening toward the eave — which produces the concave sweep of a Chinese roof.
terms.note: 屋面曲线是分段近似的，不是一条真正的圆弧；模型中应按折线而非样条生成。

terms.definitionZh: 屋檐转角处向上翘出、层层出冲的角部，是最能代表中国屋顶形态的局部。
terms.definitionEn: The upturned, layered corner of the eave — the detail that most identifies a Chinese roof.

terms.definitionZh: 屋顶斜向棱脊上覆盖的瓦件，防水同时把屋面的分坡交代清楚。
terms.definitionEn: The tiled ridge running down a roof hip; it sheds water and also states how the roof is divided into slopes.

terms.definitionZh: 屋面在顶部交汇于一点的顶式，多边形平面，常见于亭、塔与圆形殿堂。
terms.definitionEn: A roof in which all slopes meet at a single point above a polygonal plan, used for pavilions, pagodas and circular halls.

terms.definitionZh: 由一段悬山与一段庑殿复合而成的屋顶，山面有山花博风板，是等级仅次于庑殿的顶式。
terms.definitionEn: A roof combining a half-gable and a half-hip, with a decorative gable panel; the second rank of roof type after the full hip roof.

terms.definitionZh: 四面均做成斜坡、只在正面设门的高等级屋顶，帝王宫殿的常用顶式。
terms.definitionEn: A roof sloping on all four sides, entered only from the front; the highest-ranking roof form, used for imperial halls.

terms.definitionZh: 一座建筑上下叠做两道屋檐，既增加气势，也把上部构架与下部台基在视觉上分层。
terms.definitionEn: Two tiers of eaves on one building; it adds monumentality and visually separates the upper frame from the platform below.

terms.definitionZh: 柱上抬梁、梁上再抬梁，逐层收小叠成的木构架；各层梁架分工明确，室内可以通行。
terms.definitionEn: A frame in which beams are stacked tier on tier above the columns, each tier smaller than the one below, with clearly separated load-carrying levels and a walkable interior.

terms.definitionZh: 柱直接承檩，并用穿枋把各柱串成整体的木构架；室内柱列密集，南方民居常见。
terms.definitionEn: A frame in which columns carry the purlins directly and are strung together by penetrating ties; dense rows of columns fill the interior, and it is common in southern vernacular buildings.

terms.definitionZh: 下层用穿斗以提高刚度，上层用抬梁以争取高度，常用于多层楼阁。
terms.definitionEn: A frame that uses column-and-tie construction on the lower storeys for stiffness and stacked beams above for height, common in multi-storey towers.

terms.definitionZh: 地板架空于短柱之上，人居其上，底部留空以防潮防虫；中国南方与东南亚山区广泛分布。
terms.definitionEn: A structure whose floor is raised on posts above the ground so that the space underneath stays dry and ventilated; widespread in southern China and Southeast Asia.

terms.definitionZh: 横木层层叠置、转角处十字咬合的墙体做法，墙体本身即承重墙，几乎不需要梁架。
terms.definitionEn: A wall built from horizontal logs stacked course on course and notched crosswise at the corners; the wall carries the load, so almost no frame is needed.

terms.definitionZh: 殿身由内外两套梁架分别承重、内槽外套外槽的柱网布置，是唐宋大型殿堂的典型平面。
terms.definitionEn: A column arrangement in which an inner and an outer frame each carry the roof separately, the inner frame nested inside the outer — the typical plan of a large Tang or Song hall.

terms.definitionZh: 两向梁架在中心交汇的平面，四出抱厦，屋面转角随之复杂，隆兴寺摩尼殿为著名实例。
terms.definitionEn: A plan in which frames in two directions meet at the centre, with projecting porches on all four sides and correspondingly complex roof corners.

terms.definitionZh: 以小方格遮蔽梁架的平天花，作用在防火隔尘之外，也标示空间的等级。
terms.definitionEn: A flat coffered ceiling that hides the frame; beyond fire and dust protection it also signals the rank of the space.

terms.definitionZh: 天花中心向下凸出的方形木构装置，用叠落与彩画强化中心感，是室内等级的最高标志之一。
terms.definitionEn: A stepped, painted timber construction that drops from the centre of the ceiling, intensifying the focus and marking the highest interior rank.

terms.definitionZh: 由须弥山形象层层叠涩的石砌基座，用于高等级建筑与造像的承托。
terms.definitionEn: A tiered stone pedestal shaped after the mythical Mount Sumeru, used to carry high-ranking buildings and statues.

terms.definitionZh: 铺在台基顶面、把木柱与石砌台身隔开的垫木层，使上部木构与下部砌体相对滑移。
terms.definitionEn: A layer of timber laid on the platform surface that separates the timber frame from the masonry below, letting the two slide relative to each other.

terms.definitionZh: 把木构抬离地面的砖石或夯土平台，既防潮防蚁，也用高度表达建筑等级。
terms.definitionEn: A brick, stone or rammed-earth platform that lifts the timber frame clear of the ground; it keeps out damp and insects, and its height expresses rank.

terms.definitionZh: 两根相邻柱轴线之间的水平距离；开间数是建筑等级最直观的标志。
terms.definitionEn: The horizontal distance between the axes of two adjacent columns; the number of bays is the most immediately legible marker of a building's rank.

terms.definitionZh: 主体建筑四周环设一圈单檐廊的做法，礼制等级中占一档，现存实例稀少。
terms.definitionEn: A single-eave gallery running all round the main body of a hall; it occupies a distinct rank in the hierarchy, and few such examples survive.

terms.definitionZh: 在夹板内分层填土夯实而成的墙体，掺石灰与砂砾可提高强度与防水性。
terms.definitionEn: A wall built by filling earth in thin lifts between formwork boards and compacting it; lime and gravel improve strength and water resistance.

terms.definitionZh: 夯土时使用的木夹板与立柱，限制夯层宽度，保证墙体收分与平整。
terms.definitionEn: The timber boards and posts that form the mould for ramming; they control the width of each lift and keep the wall true and tapering.

terms.definitionZh: 在黄土崖壁上掏挖或在地坑中做券洞形成的居所，土体本身既是围护也是结构。
terms.definitionEn: A dwelling hollowed out of a loess cliff or formed as a vaulted pit below ground, in which the earth itself serves as both enclosure and structure.
terms.note: 「窑洞营造技艺」已列入国家级非物质文化遗产名录；陕北与甘肃庆阳做法不同。

terms.definitionZh: 未经烧结的土料，包括夯土与土坯，取材方便、透气保温，但怕水。
terms.definitionEn: Unfired earth — rammed or adobe — cheap to obtain, breathable and insulating, but vulnerable to water.

terms.definitionZh: 以竹为柱、梁、笆并用绑扎连接的轻型木构，整体轻而韧，节点老化常先于杆件失效。
terms.definitionEn: A light timber-like construction in which bamboo culms serve as posts, beams and matting, tied together at the joints; the frame is light and resilient, and its joints usually age before its members fail.

terms.definitionZh: 由可折叠的杆件组成菱形格构、外覆羊毛毡的帐幕式结构，靠张力变硬，可拆可迁。
terms.definitionEn: A collapsible lattice of poles in a diamond pattern, covered with felt; the frame stiffens under tension and can be taken down and moved with the herd.

terms.definitionZh: 以蒲草、苇秆搓成的绳索，用于捆绑与绑扎，是干栏与竹构节点常用的传统材料。
terms.definitionEn: A rope twisted from cattail or reed, used for lashing and binding; a traditional jointing material in stilted and bamboo construction.

terms.definitionZh: 用短杆件穿插编织成篮形拱架的桥梁，拱架自重承压，荷载侧向传给桥台。
terms.definitionEn: A bridge whose arch is woven from short members into a basket-like frame; the arch carries load in compression and transfers it sideways into the abutments.
terms.note: 「中国木拱桥传统营造技艺」于 2024 年 12 月由急需保护名录转入人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录。

terms.definitionZh: 编木拱桥中长度不同的两类主杆件，长短相间编织成拱。
terms.definitionEn: The two standard lengths of primary member in a woven timber arch; long and short members interlace to form the curve.

terms.definitionZh: 承接桥梁端部并把水平推力传回地基的砌体或木构支座。
terms.definitionEn: The support at the end of a bridge that receives the end bearing and returns the horizontal thrust into the ground.

terms.definitionZh: 在主拱两肩之上再开小拱以减重并泄洪的做法，赵州桥为此型代表。
terms.definitionEn: A stone arch with smaller openings above the main arch shoulders, reducing weight and doubling as flood openings; the Zhaozhou Bridge is the classic example.

terms.definitionZh: 构成拱圈的楔形石块，靠互相挤压把压力沿拱轴传下去。
terms.definitionEn: A wedge-shaped stone forming part of the arch ring; each one squeezes its neighbours, passing compression along the arch axis.

terms.definitionZh: 以整片条石或木板铺成的扩大基础，把上部集中荷载分散到软弱地基。
terms.definitionEn: An enlarged foundation of continuous stone slabs or timber that spreads concentrated loads over weak ground.

terms.definitionZh: 在桥基水下播种牡蛎，利用其分泌物与贝壳连缀固结基脚的做法，见于泉州洛阳桥。
terms.definitionEn: A technique of seeding oysters on an underwater foundation so that their shells and secretions bond the base; it is recorded at Luoyang Bridge in Quanzhou.

terms.definitionZh: 架设在桥面上、遮蔽风雨的廊式建筑，多为穿斗式木构，兼作庙会与交通空间。
terms.definitionEn: A roofed gallery built over a bridge deck, usually in a column-and-tie timber frame, sheltering travellers and serving as a communal space.

terms.definitionZh: 以铁链或绳索承托桥面、水平分力全由两岸锚碇承担的桥梁形式。
terms.definitionEn: A bridge whose deck hangs on chains or ropes, with the whole horizontal pull taken by anchorages at each bank.

terms.definitionZh: 白族民居的标准格局：三面房舍围合，正面照壁封闭院落，平面紧凑。
terms.definitionEn: The standard Bai dwelling layout: houses on three sides, a screen wall closing the fourth, forming a compact courtyard.

terms.definitionZh: 土石或混凝土砌筑的塔状居住兼防御体，墙厚窗小，孤立守卫，俯瞰村落。
terms.definitionEn: A tower-like dwelling and lookout built of earth, stone or concrete, with thick walls and small openings, standing alone to watch over a village.

terms.definitionZh: 羌族村寨中的石砌防御性高塔，顶部四角出檐，是村寨的制高点与标志。
terms.definitionEn: A masonry defensive tower in a Qiang village, its four roof corners projecting outward; it is the village's high point and landmark.

terms.definitionZh: 侗族村寨的公共中心，底层架空、层叠出檐，内部设鼓，为议事与集会之所。
terms.definitionEn: The communal centre of a Dong village, raised on an open base with stacked projecting eaves and a drum inside; it is where the village assembles and deliberates.

terms.definitionZh: 高出屋面的山墙，多用砖砌，既挡火又分隔相邻院落。
terms.definitionEn: A gable wall rising above the roof, usually in brick, that both seals against fire and separates adjoining courtyards.

terms.definitionZh: 徽州民居门楼与构件上的砖雕、木雕、石雕合称，构成本地最鲜明的装饰语言。
terms.definitionEn: Brick, wood and stone carving on Huizhou doorways and members — the three carving media that form the area's most distinctive decorative vocabulary.

terms.definitionZh: 在黄土地下挖出方形或长方形地坑，四壁做窑洞居室的院落形式，陕北常见。
terms.definitionEn: A courtyard dug down into the loess, with cave dwellings cut into its four walls; a characteristic form of northern Shaanxi.
